title: Serving what was published
summary: `ty start` serves a bundle that is already built. `server/application.json` and its profile files hold `yon` settings that are not secret. These files have no `yon` root key (top-level key). `.env` holds private Yon secrets. Public `tac` settings are already in the bundle. The deployment chooses the runtime executable and the isolation policy. `outgoing.hosts` in `server/application.json` lists the hosts that Yon code may call; at run time a local guard refuses every other host.
